name: gizza-ai/find-unique-lines
summary: Return the lines that appear exactly once in the text

tool.description: Return only the lines that appear exactly once in the text (like `uniq -u`), in first-appearance order. Lines that repeat are dropped entirely. Set ignore_case=true to compare case-insensitively and trim=true to ignore surrounding whitespace. Also reports total/distinct line counts. Runs locally.

text.description: The text whose lines should be scanned for ones that appear exactly once.

trim.description: Trim leading/trailing whitespace from each line before comparing.
